scope: Bindings describe the learner task in a scene, not every question as a separate skill assessment.

rows.rationale: “Find a teammate before choosing whom to involve.” is taught through recognition of the developing play; the opening check “Who is your teammate?” makes that learner task explicit in this scene.
“Tell a loose puck from a carried puck.” is taught through recognition of the developing play; the opening check “Who has the puck right now?” makes that learner task explicit in this scene.

“Notice an occupied route and a roomier practice area.” is taught through using available space and the time the freeze provides; the opening check “Who is directly ahead of YOU?” makes that learner task explicit in this scene.
Rink landmark vocabulary has no direct ledger concept. Do not substitute tactical reading for naming a faceoff circle.
Recognizing a practice whistle is a practice-safety/rules task, not a tactical transition.

Recognizes the defended goal and nearby crease in a stated turn; this is orientation, not a possession-transition assessment.
